findings.issue: Exact-pinned to the newest major, astro 7.4.4 (7.0 released 2026-06-22, only ~4 months old), so the project rides the newest major-release churn even though no new APIs are used
findings.suggestion: Nothing to change; just be aware 7.x minors have been shipping rapidly (7.1, 7.2, 7.3 within three months). Pinning exact versions as done here is a reasonable mitigation

summary: This app is deliberately conservative: it pins the current Astro 7 major but uses only APIs that have been stable since Astro 1–5 (props, params, url, response.status, Astro.self, set:html, output: 'server', the Node adapter). None of Astro 7's headline features — Advanced Routing, stabilized route caching, experimental CDN cache providers — are touched. Framework-adjacent logic (config, adapter setup, HTTP fetching/caching) is cleanly isolated in astro.config.mjs and src/lib/pokeapi.ts, so experimentalness risk is essentially zero.
